svg.aria-label: W-09: the vendor wraps the search tool and leaves internal_admin_lookup unwrapped to keep it private. When the AI fills in the goal field, the unwrapped tool still reports its name and the goal text to Within, and with argument capture on its arguments too. Fix: report only wrapped tools, or make it an opt-in. Prototype P6 makes the check pass.
svg.title: W-09: an unwrapped tool still reports to Within
svg.text: 14 · W-09: a tool the vendor did NOT wrap still reports
The docs say: wrap the tools you want Within to see. The SDK hooks every registerTool tool registered after install.
What the vendor set up
search ................ wrapped ✓
internal_admin_lookup .. NOT wrapped
the vendor's thinking: leave the
sensitive one out, to keep it private
AI call
What reached Within (stand-in server)
no goal text from the AI: nothing sent.
AI adds a goal to the unwrapped tool:
toolName: "internal_admin_lookup"
mcpIntent: "HR wants Priya Raman's salary"
argument capture on: the arguments go too
"salary of Priya Raman (617) 555-0142"
What we saw (check C7)
The SDK reports any tool that is not already flagged as wrapped, as soon as the AI has filled in the goal field.
Without a goal text, the unwrapped tool sent nothing (0 reports). With one, it reported.
Why it matters, and the fix
Leaving a tool unwrapped does not keep it private.
Fix: report only wrapped tools, or make reporting of other tools an explicit opt-in option, and say so in the docs.
Prototype P6 (reportUnwrappedTools: true to opt in): C7 passes. Details: FINDINGS.md, W-09.
